title: nostalgia — bless

sentences.sentence: He might be influenced by nostalgia for the surroundings of his happy youth.
sentences.translation: 他也许被他对快乐青年时代的环境的怀念影响了。

sentences.sentence: A hungry wolf's attempts to fatten a chicken for his stewpot have unexpected results.
sentences.translation: 一条饥饿的狼想把鸡养肥来做炖鸡，却产生了意想不到的结果。

sentences.sentence: New heat-resistant stewpot and tableware stand proudly without peer in this generation.
sentences.translation: 本厂新产品，耐高温炖盅餐具，堪称旷世无双。

sentences.sentence: Once the instru-ments are worn out, the musicians, and a conductor who doubles as cook, toss each onesintosa stewpot to make soup -- to be enjoyed by the audience after the concert.
sentences.translation: 这些乐器若是用坏了,乐手们和指挥(他还兼厨师)就把它们扔到锅里做汤,在音乐会之后让观众们享用。

sentences.sentence: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
sentences.translation: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

phrases.translation: 信息产业部；产业部；资讯产业部

sentences.sentence: ...the Ministry of Justice.
sentences.translation: …司法部。

sentences.sentence: Julia: What can you do in Toronto?
sentences.translation: 朱莉娅：在多伦多能玩些什么？

sentences.sentence: It is easier to tell where in England someone is from than it is to tell if someone is from Denver or Toronto.
sentences.translation: 可以说你想判断一个英国人来自英国的哪个城市都要比判断一个人到底是来自丹佛还是多伦多容易。

sentences.sentence: About 830 people on Facebook have replied they would attend the event in Toronto.
sentences.translation: 大约有830人在脸书上回覆称他们会参与这个多伦多的活动。

sentences.sentence: He was narrowly defeated in the election.
sentences.translation: 他在选举中以微弱差距败北。

sentences.sentence: One bullet struck his car, narrowly missing him.
sentences.translation: 一颗子弹击中了他的汽车，差点打中他。

sentences.sentence: A man narrowly escaped death when a fire broke out in his home on Sunday morning.
sentences.translation: 周日早晨一名男子家中起火，险些丧命。

translations.translation: 熟练, 精通, 熟练程度

phrases.translation: 能力验证；技术检查；熟练测试

sentences.sentence: I brought her proficiency up to the required level.
sentences.translation: 我把她的熟练程度提高到所规定的水平。

sentences.sentence: With study and practice, almost anyone can do it with some level of proficiency, but most people don't learn how to think critically or analytically—nor are they even aware of its value.
sentences.translation: 通过学习和实践，几乎任何人都能以不同的熟练程度来掌握它，但是大多数人都不会去学习如何进行批判性或分析性思维，或者说，他们根本意识不到其价值。

sentences.sentence: How do you think of your proficiency in written and spoken English?
sentences.translation: 你认为你的书面 英语和 口语熟练程度如何？

sentences.sentence: Meanwhile, industry, civil society groups and governments continue to spar over the application of intellectual property rights to products and genetic sequences derived from natural resources.
sentences.translation: 其间，工业、民间社会团体以及政府持续对申请产品和得自自然资源的基因序列的知识产权问题产生争论。

sentences.sentence: Do you like your hometown?
sentences.translation: 你喜欢你的家乡吗？

sentences.sentence: She expressed the wish to be interred in the graveyard of hometown.
sentences.translation: 她表达了死后葬在故乡的墓地上的愿望。

phrases.translation: 经济社会学；社会经济学
城市社会学，都市社会学

sentences.sentence: Out with every theory of human behavior, from linguistics to sociology.
sentences.translation: 从语言学、社会学的人类行为原理里解脱吧。

sentences.sentence: Basic courses in sociology and psychology as well as other humanities courses give students plenty of opportunity to explore their own emotions.
sentences.translation: 社会学和心理学的基础，以及其他人文学科的课程，赋予学生大量的机会去探索其个人情感。

sentences.sentence: And I spent part of my second grade year in Sweden, where my father was on sabbatical as a professor of sociology.
sentences.translation: 因为我父亲休假的缘故，我的小学二年级有一段时间是在瑞典上的，那个时候他是一名社会学教授。

sentences.translation: 在生面团中加一些葡萄干。

sentences.translation: 一位面包师正在揉面团。

sentences.sentence: She patted the dough into a flat cake.
sentences.translation: 她把面团轻轻拍成扁饼。

sentences.translation: 乔有语言天赋。

sentences.translation: …深奥难懂的知识。

sentences.translation: …一种会使齐格弗里德忘掉布伦希德尔德而爱上古特鲁内娜的魔剂。

translations.translation: 炼金药, 不老长寿药

sentences.translation: 寻找长生不老药

translations.translation: 分不开地, 无法摆脱地

sentences.sentence: Our survival is inextricably linked to the survival of the rainforest.
sentences.translation: 我们的生存与雨林的生存息息相关。

sentences.sentence: vague imprecise estimates
sentences.translation: 粗略的、不精确的估计

sentences.sentence: Alcohol affects the brain, making speech slurred and imprecise.
sentences.translation: 酒精影响大脑，使言语含糊不清。

sentences.sentence: The United States bestowed honorary citizenship upon England's World War II prime minister, Sir Winston Churchill.
sentences.translation: 美国授予了二战期间的英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔爵士荣誉公民的称号。

sentences.sentence: He’s always willing to help. Bless him!
sentences.translation: 他一向乐于助人，愿上帝保佑他！

sentences.sentence: ‘Jess made this card for me.’ ‘Bless!’
sentences.translation: “杰斯给我做了这张卡。”“真不错！”

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 460 单元

nostalgia
音标：英 /nɒ'stældʒə/  美 /nə'stældʒə/
n. 乡愁, 怀旧之情
例句：He might be influenced by nostalgia for the surroundings of his happy youth.
他也许被他对快乐青年时代的环境的怀念影响了。

stewpot
音标：英 /'stjuːpɒt/  美 /'stjʊ,pɑt/
n. 双把炖锅
例句：A hungry wolf's attempts to fatten a chicken for his stewpot have unexpected results.
一条饥饿的狼想把鸡养肥来做炖鸡，却产生了意想不到的结果。
例句：New heat-resistant stewpot and tableware stand proudly without peer in this generation.
本厂新产品，耐高温炖盅餐具，堪称旷世无双。
例句：Once the instru-ments are worn out, the musicians, and a conductor who doubles as cook, toss each onesintosa stewpot to make soup -- to be enjoyed by the audience after the concert.
这些乐器若是用坏了,乐手们和指挥(他还兼厨师)就把它们扔到锅里做汤,在音乐会之后让观众们享用。

adolescence
音标：英 /ædə'les(ə)ns/  美 /,ædə'lɛsns/
n. 青春期
短语：late adolescence — 青春晚期
例句：Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

ministry
音标：英 /'mɪnɪstrɪ/  美 /'mɪnɪstri/
n. (政府的)部门
短语：ministry of education — 教育部
短语：ministry of finance — 财政部
短语：ministry of agriculture — 农业部
短语：ministry of commerce — 商业部
短语：foreign ministry — 外交部；外务省
短语：ministry of health — 卫生部
短语：ministry of public security — 公安部；中国公安部
短语：ministry of foreign trade — 外贸部
短语：ministry of foreign affairs — 外交部
短语：ministry of culture — 文化部
短语：ministry of information industry — 信息产业部；产业部；资讯产业部
短语：ministry of communications — 交通部
短语：ministry of railways — 铁道部，铁路部
短语：finance ministry — 财政部
短语：ministry of justice — 司法部
短语：ministry of civil affairs — 民政部
短语：ministry of personnel — 人事部
短语：ministry of water resources — 水利部
短语：commerce ministry — 商务部
短语：ministry of chemical industry — 化学工业部
例句：...the Ministry of Justice.
…司法部。

Toronto
音标：英 /təˈrɒntəʊ/  美 /tə'rɑnto/
n. 多伦多（加拿大）
短语：university of toronto — 多伦多大学
例句：Julia: What can you do in Toronto?
朱莉娅：在多伦多能玩些什么？
例句：It is easier to tell where in England someone is from than it is to tell if someone is from Denver or Toronto.
可以说你想判断一个英国人来自英国的哪个城市都要比判断一个人到底是来自丹佛还是多伦多容易。
例句：About 830 people on Facebook have replied they would attend the event in Toronto.
大约有830人在脸书上回覆称他们会参与这个多伦多的活动。

narrowly
音标：英 /'nærəʊlɪ/  美 /'næroli/
adv. 勉强地, 精细地
例句：He was narrowly defeated in the election.
他在选举中以微弱差距败北。
例句：One bullet struck his car, narrowly missing him.
一颗子弹击中了他的汽车，差点打中他。
例句：A man narrowly escaped death when a fire broke out in his home on Sunday morning.
周日早晨一名男子家中起火，险些丧命。

proficiency
音标：英 /prə'fɪʃ(ə)nsɪ/  美 /prə'fɪʃənsi/
n. 熟练, 精通, 熟练程度
短语：proficiency in — 熟练；精通
短语：english proficiency — 英语水平；英文能力
短语：proficiency test — 水平测试；熟练测验
短语：proficiency testing — 能力验证；技术检查；熟练测试
例句：I brought her proficiency up to the required level.
我把她的熟练程度提高到所规定的水平。
例句：With study and practice, almost anyone can do it with some level of proficiency, but most people don't learn how to think critically or analytically—nor are they even aware of its value.
通过学习和实践，几乎任何人都能以不同的熟练程度来掌握它，但是大多数人都不会去学习如何进行批判性或分析性思维，或者说，他们根本意识不到其价值。
例句：How do you think of your proficiency in written and spoken English?
你认为你的书面 英语和 口语熟练程度如何？

spar
音标：英 /spɑː/  美 /spɑr/
n. 争论,园材(如桅,桁等)
短语：iceland spar — [矿]冰洲石（方解石的一种）
例句：Meanwhile, industry, civil society groups and governments continue to spar over the application of intellectual property rights to products and genetic sequences derived from natural resources.
其间，工业、民间社会团体以及政府持续对申请产品和得自自然资源的基因序列的知识产权问题产生争论。

hometown
音标：英 /'həʊm'taʊn/  美 /'homtaʊn/
n. 故乡
例句：Do you like your hometown?
你喜欢你的家乡吗？
例句：She expressed the wish to be interred in the graveyard of hometown.
她表达了死后葬在故乡的墓地上的愿望。

sociology
音标：英 /səʊsɪ'ɒlədʒɪ; səʊʃɪ-/  美 /,sosɪ'ɑlədʒi/
n. 社会学
短语：sociology of law — 法律社会学
短语：economic sociology — 经济社会学；社会经济学
短语：urban sociology — 城市社会学，都市社会学
短语：sociology of knowledge — 知识社会学
短语：sociology of science — 科学社会学
短语：educational sociology — 教育社会学
短语：rural sociology — 田园社会学
例句：Out with every theory of human behavior, from linguistics to sociology.
从语言学、社会学的人类行为原理里解脱吧。
例句：Basic courses in sociology and psychology as well as other humanities courses give students plenty of opportunity to explore their own emotions.
社会学和心理学的基础，以及其他人文学科的课程，赋予学生大量的机会去探索其个人情感。
例句：And I spent part of my second grade year in Sweden, where my father was on sabbatical as a professor of sociology.
因为我父亲休假的缘故，我的小学二年级有一段时间是在瑞典上的，那个时候他是一名社会学教授。

dough
音标：英 /dəʊ/  美 /do/
n. 生面团
例句：Add some raisins to the dough.
在生面团中加一些葡萄干。
例句：A baker is kneading a dough.
一位面包师正在揉面团。
例句：She patted the dough into a flat cake.
她把面团轻轻拍成扁饼。

flair
音标：英 /fleə/  美 /flɛr/
n. 才能, 本领
例句：Jo has a flair for languages.
乔有语言天赋。

esoteric
音标：英 /,esə'terɪk; ,iːsə-/  美 /,ɛsə'tɛrɪk/
adj. 秘传的,  神秘的,  难懂的
短语：esoteric buddhism — 密宗（秘教性的佛教）
例句：...esoteric knowledge.
…深奥难懂的知识。

potion
音标：英 /'pəʊʃ(ə)n/  美 /'poʃən/
n. 一服, 一剂
例句：...a magic potion that will make Siegfried forget Brunnhilde and fall in love with Gutrune.
…一种会使齐格弗里德忘掉布伦希德尔德而爱上古特鲁内娜的魔剂。

laboriously
adv. 艰难地,  辛勤地

elixir
音标：英 /ɪ'lɪksə; -sɪə/  美 /ɪ'lɪksɚ/
n. 炼金药, 不老长寿药
例句：the search for the elixir of life
寻找长生不老药

inextricably
音标：英 /ˌɪnɪkˈstrɪkəbli/  美 /ˌɪnɪkˈstrɪkəbli/
adv. 分不开地, 无法摆脱地
例句：Our survival is inextricably linked to the survival of the rainforest.
我们的生存与雨林的生存息息相关。

imprecise
音标：英 /ɪmprɪ'saɪs/  美 /'ɪmprɪ'saɪs/
adj. 不精确的
例句：vague imprecise estimates
粗略的、不精确的估计
例句：Alcohol affects the brain, making speech slurred and imprecise.
酒精影响大脑，使言语含糊不清。

bestow
音标：英 /bɪ'stəʊ/  美 /bɪ'sto/
v. 给予,利用
例句：The United States bestowed honorary citizenship upon England's World War II prime minister, Sir Winston Churchill.
美国授予了二战期间的英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔爵士荣誉公民的称号。

bless
音标：英 /bles/  美 /blɛs/
v. 祝福, 保佑
短语：god bless — 上帝保佑
例句：He’s always willing to help. Bless him!
他一向乐于助人，愿上帝保佑他！
例句：‘Jess made this card for me.’ ‘Bless!’
“杰斯给我做了这张卡。”“真不错！”
